introduce: Stand in front of a wall one big step away from it. Then put your hands out straight towards the wall and lean against it. Lift your heels.\n\nSlowly bend your elbows and press your upper body towards the wall. Push back and repeat the exercise. Remember to keep your body straight.
name: WALL PUSH-UPS

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your body straight.
Tighten your abs.
Inhale when bending your arms, and exhale when stretching them out.
To make it harder, perform a traditional push-up on the floor.
This exercise primarily targets your chest and arms.

introduce: Start in the regular push-up position, then let your knees touch the floor and raise your feet up off the floor. \n\nNext push your body up and down.
name: KNEE PUSH-UPS

tips.text: You need to do it on a mat.
Your body should be straight.
Tighten your abdominals.
Don't rotate your shoulders towards your chest.
Don't drop or raise your head.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
To make it more difficult, perform a traditional push-up.
Your should not feel too much pressure on your shoulders.
This exercise targets all the major muscle groups of your upper body.

introduce: Hold your forearms together at shoulder height and bend your elbows with your hands together to make an \'L\' shape.\n\nThen lift your forearms up and down.
name: CHEST PRESS PULSE

tips.text: Your elbows should be at shoulder height.
Squeeze your forearms together.
Breathe regularly.
Too easy? Try harder to push your forearms together.
If your arms are sore, don't worry, it's working.
This exercise works on your shoulders and biceps.

introduce:
Stand on the floor with your arms extended straight to the side at shoulder height. 

Move your arms clockwise in big circles fast. 

Try to do it as fast as you can.

It's a great exercise for the deltoid muscle.
name: CLOCKWISE ARM SWINGS

tips.text: Breathe regularly during the exercise.
If it’s too easy for you, you can hold dumbbells in your hands.

introduce:
Stand on the floor with your arms extended straight to the side at shoulder height. 

Move your arms counterclockwise in big circles fast. 

Try to do it as fast as you can.

It's a great exercise for the deltoid muscle.
name: COUNTERCLOCKWISE ARM SWINGS

tips.text: Breathe regularly during the exercise.
If it’s too easy for you, you can hold dumbbells in your hands.

introduce:
Start in the straight arm plank position. 

Then bend your right arm and place your forearm on the ground with your elbow under your shoulder, then bend your left arm and come down into the traditional plank position. 

Then reverse and come back to the start position. Repeat the exercise.

Keep your body straight during the exercise. Inhale when you come down and exhale when you come up.

It's a great exercise for the quadriceps, triceps and abdominal muscles.
name: UP AND DOWN PLANK

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your core tight.
Please keep your legs extended straight.
Please keep your head, neck and spine aligned.
Please don\'t sink or raise your hips.
This exercise strengthens and tones your core, arms, glutes, wrists and shoulders.

introduce:
Lean forward, bend your knees and your elbows.

Extend your arms behind you and squeeze your triceps. Please make your arms parallel to the ground when extending them.

Go back to the start position, and repeat this exercise.
name: TRICEPS KICKBACKS

tips.text: Please keep your neck and spine in line.
Please fully extend your arms when kicking them back.
Please squeeze your triceps when kicking your arms back.
Please don\'t move your upper arm.
Exhale when extending your arms, and inhale when bringing them back.
If you feel it’s too easy, you can hold dumbbells in your hands.
It’s an excellent exercise for the triceps muscles.

introduce:
Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart.

Stretch your arms in front of you at shoulder height with one arm overlap the other in the shape of the letter “X”, and then spread them apart.

Switch arms, and repeat the exercise.
name: ARM SCISSORS

tips.text: Please always keep your arms at shoulder height.
If it\'s too easy for you, you can hold dumbbells in your hands.

introduce: Put your left hand on your back, use your right hand to grab your left elbow and gently pull it. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: TRICEPS STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please make sure that your elbow is bent to the max.
You should feel a stretch on your triceps.
Please press your left shoulder down when pulling your left elbow.
This workout stretches your triceps and helps improve your shoulder mobility.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Put your right hand on your back, use your left hand to grab your right elbow and gently pull it. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: TRICEPS STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please make sure that your elbow is bent to the max.
You should feel a stretch on your triceps.
Please press your right shoulder down when pulling your right elbow.
This workout stretches your triceps and helps improve your shoulder mobility.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, and place your dominant foot slightly forward. Slightly bend your knees, clench your fists and bend your elbows at 90 degrees. \n\nRaise your right arm to shoulder height and keep your forearm parallel to the ground. Rotate your shoulders and hips and punch towards the left. Switch sides and repeat.
name: ALTERNATING HOOKS

tips.text: Keep your elbows at 90 degrees.
Rotate your shoulders and hips.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Always keep your core engaged.

introduce: Sit down with your legs bent, place your hands shoulder-width apart on the ground behind you, and make sure your fingers are facing sideways.\n\nLift your hips until your upper body is parallel to the ground and walk forward with your hands and feet.
name: CRAB WALK

tips.text: Please make sure that your arms are straight.
You should feel the pressure on your shoulders.
